title: Comfort Club Automatic Renewal, Lapse and Renewal Preferences
content:
Membership terms for the end of a term on Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements.

1. **Renewal notice.** The renewal notice is sent the tier's renewal notice days before the term ends.
2. **Automatic renewal.** On the day after the term ends, an agreement in active status whose automatic renewal is on renews. The new term starts the day after the old term ended and ends one day before the same calendar date a term length later; the count of consecutive terms increases by one; renewal dues are billed under the dues pricing rules; the new term's visits and covered-repair benefit are granted, while the old term's unused visits and benefit expire.
3. **Only active agreements renew.** Only an agreement in active status on its term end date is renewed.
4. **Lapse.** An active agreement whose automatic renewal is off lapses on the day after the term ends, and its unused visits and benefit expire.
5. **Past due at term end.** An agreement that is past due at term end is neither renewed nor lapsed on that day. If it is cured before it is terminated, it renews on the day it returns to active, with the new term still starting the day after the old term ended. If it is not cured, it is terminated under the dues collection rules.
6. **Changing the renewal setting.** The member may turn automatic renewal off or on at any time while the agreement is active or past due, up to and including the term end date. A change made after the term end date has no effect on the term already renewed or lapsed.
7. **Changes applied at renewal.** A confirmed request to downgrade at renewal is applied at the next renewal by writing the requested tier for the new term, and a member's request to switch billing frequency is applied at the next renewal in the same way.

### Term-end outcomes

| Status on the term end date | Automatic renewal | Day after term end |
|---|---|---|
| Active | On | Renews into the new term |
| Active | Off | Lapses; unused visits and benefit expire |
| Past due | On or off | Neither renewed nor lapsed that day; renews on the day it is cured (new term still dated from the day after the old term ended), or is terminated if not cured |

### Dates (hypothetical)
A 12-month term ending 31 May 2025 renews into a term running from 1 June 2025 to 31 May 2026. With a 30-day renewal notice, the notice goes out on 1 May 2025.

### Points of judgement
- A member who turns automatic renewal off on the term end date itself is in time; the agreement lapses the next day.
- A member who turns it back on two days after a lapse does not undo the lapse.
